nodes.summary: Let $p$ be an odd prime, let $a \in \{1, 2\}$, and let $F$ be a finite field with $q = p^a$ elements. A natural number $N$ is the number $\#E(F)$ of $F$-points (counting the point at infinity) of some elliptic curve $E$ over $F$ with $4 \mid N$ if and only if there are natural numbers $l$ and $m$ with $N = 2m$, $2l + m = q + 1$, $m > 0$ and $(2l - m)^2 \le 4q$.
nodes.title: Elliptic curves with point count divisible by 4 and Ramanujan graphs on two vertices

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $a \ge 1$, and let $F$ be a finite field with $q = p^a$ elements. nodes.summary: Let $W$ be a Weierstrass curve over a finite field $F$ with $q$ elements, and let $\#W(F)$ be the number of nonsingular $F$-points of $W$, counting the point at infinity. The Frobenius trace of $W$ is the integer $a_q(W) = q + 1 - \#W(F)$.

nodes.title: Ramanujan graphs give Weil numbers

nodes.summary: Let $W$ be a Weierstrass curve over a finite field $F$ with $q$ elements, and let $\#W(F)$ be the number of nonsingular $F$-points of $W$, counting the point at infinity. Then $\#W(F) + a_q(W) = q + 1$, where $a_q(W)$ is the Frobenius trace of $W$.
nodes.title: Point count plus Frobenius trace

nodes.summary: Let $W$ be a Weierstrass curve over a finite field $F$ with $q$ elements, and let $\#W(F)$ be the number of nonsingular $F$-points of $W$, counting the point at infinity. Then $\#W(F) = q + 1 - a_q(W)$, where $a_q(W)$ is the Frobenius trace of $W$.
nodes.title: Point count from the Frobenius trace

nodes.summary: Let $W$ be an elliptic curve in Weierstrass form over a finite field $F$. The number of $F$-points of $W$, counting the point at infinity, is one more than the number of pairs $(x, y) \in F \times F$ satisfying the Weierstrass equation of $W$.
nodes.title: Point count from affine solutions

nodes.summary: Let $W$ be a Weierstrass curve over a finite field $F$ with $q$ elements. The number of nonsingular $F$-points of $W$, counting the point at infinity, is at most $2q + 1$.
nodes.title: Upper bound on the point count

nodes.summary: Let $q \ge 2$ be a natural number and let $A$ be a symmetric $n \times n$ matrix with integer entries. Every complex root $\mu \ne q + 1$ of the characteristic polynomial of $A$ satisfies $|\mu| \le 2\sqrt{q}$ if and only if, for every such root $\mu \ne q + 1$, every complex number $s$ with $1 - \mu q^{-s} + q^{1 - 2s} = 0$ has real part $1/2$.
nodes.title: Ihara's criterion for Ramanujan graphs

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
